name: Toulouse Hyperspectral Data Set
description: A hyperspectral image benchmark dataset for assessing semi-supervised spectral representation learning and pixel-wise classification techniques.
notes: Non-LLM hyperspectral benchmark. Common caveats include class imbalance, spectral variability, sensor-specific characteristics, and potential small/region-specific sample sizes; reported metrics often include OA, average accuracy (AA), and kappa.
